title: feat(agent-frugal): cost-first, health-aware model router code agent
author: fadyabohamza-netizen
pr_body_excerpt:
> Maintainer update (September 28): preserves structured tool history; excludes agent/unknown-price entries; checks context and capabilities; no unchecked fallback. Estimates request cost, not exact usage. 29 tests, TypeScript, formatting and three live routing tiers verified. Published name: community/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal. Standalone deployment still needs the author to copy/sync these changes.

## frugal — cost-first, health-aware model router (code agent)

A code agent that routes each request to the **cheapest healthy model that can actually serve it**, then forwards the conversation unchanged. Routing costs zero tokens: the tier decision is pure code, and the pick is a live ranking of true per-request cost.

- **Source repository:** https://github.com/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal
- **Callable model:** `fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal` (deployed, verified live)

## How it routes

1. **Classify (zero-LM)**: prompt length, code fences, reasoning/long-form keywords, conversation continuation, images, tools → `FAST` / `BALANCED` / `DEEP`. No classifier model call ⇒ no extra tokens or latency spent on routing.
2. **Live data in parallel** via `pollinations()`: `/v1/models` (pricing, capabilities, modality) + `/models/status?minutes=30` (per-model rollup: requests, 5xx, failure shares).
3. **True per-request cost, not unit price**: `input_tokens × prompt_price + tier_scaled_output_tokens × completion_price`, using the *actual measured input length*.
4. **Continuous health penalty** instead of a hard ban: recent 5xx inflates estimated cost up to 5×, so briefly-flaky models stay available but healthy models of similar price always win. Only genuinely dead models (≥15% 5xx, or zero 2xx with real traffic) are dropped.
5. **Foundation models only**: `community` entries (games/agents/tests) and unpriced entries are excluded, so the router never routes to itself or to unpredictable test agents.

gist.headline: A thrifty little router
gist.blurb: Community contributor fadyabohamza-netizen built frugal, a code agent that shops the live model catalog before sending your request along. It checks price, health, context, and capabilities without spending tokens on the decision.
gist.summary: Added the community code agent `community/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal`, which classifies requests in code and ranks live foundation models by estimated per-request cost, recent health, and ability to handle the conversation.
gist.impact: Developers can call frugal to route code-agent requests to a low-cost healthy model that supports their context, images, and tools while preserving structured tool history; its cost estimate is not an exact usage bill.
